facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document records the Implementation of a common interoperability framework governing secure data exchange within government indicator at a baseline of No, with the project to define and adopt the Common Interoperability Framework (CIF) and a National Strategy of Interoperability; the document is dated 15 June 2021.

The appraisal document sets the baseline for government entities actively and securely exchanging data on the government interoperability platform at 0, with a target of 5; the legal text making the CIF applicable is still to be drafted under the project (document dated 15 June 2021).

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication and Digital Economy (MCDE), with ANINF support
systems.tiers: all State ministries, departments and agencies (intended)
government entities connected to the secure platform (planned)
